description: The agent AUTHORS its Bayesian-Program-Learning recogniser from its OWN measured evidence — no teacher. A BplComponent per generative piece it built across this arc (whole-figure smooth deformation, canonical parts, shape contexts, marginalising parse inference, the learned/relational attempts), each carrying the marginal_gain the agent MEASURED for it (its expertise) and whether it PRESERVES structure. author_include is the agent's combine-all decision: include a component in the program iff its measured marginal_gain > 0 (it lifted the fused score). author_residual reads the agent's own excluded set — every excluded piece DISCARDS structure — and authors the spec for the missing BPL piece: a STRUCTURE-PRESERVING learned per-primitive generative model with joint inference (the dual of why its learned attempts failed). The DECISIONS are the Rules over the agent's measured evidence; the host assembles the included components and measures.

microtheory.name: bpl_authoring
microtheory.description: compose the generative program from measured evidence; author the residual piece

effects.name: learned_per_primitive_structure_preserving
effects.rationale: every excluded piece DISCARDS structure; BPL's residual is a learned per-primitive generative model that PRESERVES the part layout, with joint inference
